proposals.explanation: Endpoint-only constructors initialize diagnostics, endpoint and API version and build a pipeline with no added authentication policies, accepting null options by creating defaults.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The constructors are implemented in a partial client under src/Custom, outside Generated, alongside explicit constructor suppression attributes.

proposals.subtype: Key authentication with conditional regional policy
proposals.explanation: Key-credential overloads add AzureKeyCredentialPolicy for Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key, add a regional authentication policy only for nonblank non-global regions, and replace the endpoint path with /translator/text when IsPlatformHost returns true.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The src/Custom partial client explicitly suppresses generated key-credential constructors and supplies these replacement overloads.

proposals.subtype: Configurable bearer-token scope and platform endpoint
proposals.explanation: Token-credential overloads select the default endpoint/scope or accept an explicit endpoint and tokenScope, build a BearerTokenAuthenticationPolicy pipeline, and select /translator/text when IsPlatformHost returns true.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Generated token constructors are explicitly suppressed in the src/Custom partial client, which contains the replacement pipeline construction.

proposals.explanation: Two token-credential overloads accept resourceId, region and tokenScope and construct TextTranslationAADAuthenticationPolicy with those values, using the default or caller-supplied endpoint.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Both concrete overload bodies are in src/Custom/TextTranslationClient.cs, rather than Generated, and extend the partial client.

proposals.subtype: Async text/model overloads with typed result projection
proposals.explanation: TranslateAsync overloads wrap a single string into a sequence, map strings into TranslateInputItem/TranslationTarget with source language, wrap model sequences in TranslateBody and project TranslationResult.Value while preserving the raw response. The single-model overload returns FirstOrDefault from the list response.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The partial client is under src/Custom and explicitly suppresses the generated TranslateAsync convenience signature before supplying these bodies.

proposals.subtype: Sync text/model overloads with typed result projection
proposals.explanation: Translate overloads normalize single strings and string sequences into translation input models, delegate model sequences through TranslateBody to the protocol overload and return TranslationResult.Value with its raw response. A single input model selects FirstOrDefault from the list response.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: These are concrete methods in the src/Custom partial client with an explicit CodeGenSuppress for the generated Translate convenience signature.

proposals.explanation: The captured TransliterateAsync overloads validate text/language/scripts, wrap a single string in a collection and map a string sequence to InputTextItem objects while forwarding the supplied trace ID and cancellation token.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The src/Custom partial client explicitly suppresses a generated TransliterateAsync signature and supplies the two visible adapter bodies.
